answer: Proof, not pledges: Jewel engraver drilled bead seal faceted in the lapidary shop asks for each drilled bead is a measured gem yield plus a guild signature, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. An honest agent spends 22 minutes once; the farm spends 15642 minutes and still owns nothing it can sell. The farm practised the sparrow, it practised the tide, but it never practised the nectar, because a year cannot be practised. The kiln keeps its own log, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two.
